profile.headline: RETIRED Theoretical Physicist & Real-Time Embedded Firmware (Software) Engineer
profile.summary:
Over 30 years domestic and international experience developing software, firmware and a wide variety of systems and devices impacting defense, commercial business, aviation, petroleum, communications (radio jamming), missile radar simulation, avionics, scientific software, ballistics, broadband/telecommunications, cable broadband, IPTV software quality assurance. 

Languages: Ada, C, C++, OCCUM Parallel Programming
Hardware: Analog Devices DSP, Texas Instruments DSP, Motorola 68000, Cryptographic Hardware, Intel. 
Operating Systems: Linux, Unix. Embedded Linux, Vrtx, VxWorks, Proprietary

positions.title: RETIRED Theoretical Physicist & Real-Time Embedded Firmware (Software) Engineer
Technical Lead I Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led team for IPTV DVB-T development with third party contractors in Sweden, England, and locally;
        project was highly successfully and completed on time and on budget.
     Selected by upper management as team lead for the IPTV client conditional access development.
     Drafted into development of new IPTV settop client for an end-to-end solution for telecommunication
        customers.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: How can I change my profile picture?

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: At Confocus, I developed embedded C and C++ for Cable Settop boxes. That contract to hire was contingent on Confocus getting a contract with a potential client and that contract wasn't approved.

positions.title: Lead Embedded Test Engineer
positions.description: I was onsite for Xpansion at Concurrent developing a test plan and automated tests for their Video On Demand servers. The plan was I would be team lead here developing acceptance test plans and automated testing so the testing could be outsource to India. Based on my work, Xpansion developed a formal proposal and submitted to the local Concurrent management who accepted it. However, when the local Concurrent submitted it to their corporate, it was not approved so the contracted ended.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed embedded software for Scientific Atlanta's first digital headend.
     Developed built-in test, Performance Monitoring and Analysis for caqams, mqams, gqams and netcrypts.
     Implemented SNMP on mqams and gqams (quadrature amplitude modulator).
     Led and mentored five new engineers on headend conditional access team consisting of
         encryption/decryption for pay-per-view, video on demand and broadcast. Received special recognition and
         award.
     Designed and developed conditional access cryptographic software to automatically detect failure or
         absence of single source proprietary cryptographic hardware and switch from a hardware to a software
         solution. Product life cycle using this technology extended far beyond expectations.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed real-time embedded Ada and C software targeted to an Intel Pentium to drive National Hybrids,
        Inc. (NHI) 1553 BUS interface devices for a C130J Aircraft Cargo Handling System.
     Designed and developed embedded software with project plans and documentation in compliance with
        DOD and FAA specifications.
     Developed C and C++ Windows interfaces for testing embedded software.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: At Avionics Displays, I developed a display load management system for C130 cargo planes for Lockheed Dobbins for the US Air Force. I don't know if Avionics Displays was formerly acquired by L3 or how they merged. I do understand many of the Avionics Display people ended up at L3.

positions.title: Physicist & Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Team Lead developing real-time embedded Digital Signal Processor (DSP) firmware in Ada for a Tactical Communications Jammer.
Led a team designing, developing and deploying embedded Ada software for a tactical communications jammer including success reviews and presentations with DOD overview committees in compliance with DOD-STD-2167A specifications.
Developed, integrated and deployed Radar Environment Simulators with Occam Parallel Programming Language and INMOS Transputers for the SAAB Missile Division in Sweden

company.name: AEL INDUSTRIES, INC., CROSS SYSTEMS DIVISION

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Security Clearance
     Developed system control ladder logic embedded software for controlling offshore oil drilling.
     Developed embedded software for a Mono HUD (Heads Up Display) deployed on Black Hawk
        Helicopters.

positions.title: Staff Physicist (Software Engineer)
positions.description:
Developed real time DSP embedded software for the DASP integrated into the microwave antenna
         analyzer. The DASP enjoyed a production life span of over 20 years far exceeding it's expected lifetime.
      Developed embedded software for automated telecommunication analysis systems.

positions.title: Senior Physicist (Software Engineer)
positions.description:
Developed software design specifications for a microwave receiver.
Physicist II (Software Engineer)
      Developed and Conducted spherical near-field analysis seminars and classes for customers, sales people and field service.
      Developed automated antenna analyzer systems and spherical near-field antenna analysis software.
         Included graphics, system controllers and database management in menu driven, test file oriented
         environments.
Physicist I (Software Engineer)
      Developed spherical near field analysis software.
      Developed software enabling replacement of an obsolete black and white raster scan antenna pattern
         recorder with a color vector pattern recorder. The antenna pattern recorder was the first product developed by
         Scientific Atlanta.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Theoretical Physics
